Module com.hft.systems.affinity
Package com.faster.affinity.cache

Class BoundedCache<K,V>

java.lang.Object
com.faster.affinity.cache.BoundedCache<K,V>
public final class BoundedCache<K,V> extends Object
Thread-safe bounded cache with LRU eviction policy. Provides memory-safe caching for HFT environments with configurable size limits and automatic eviction to prevent memory leaks.
